Implemented and landed locally: visible blocked-editing alternative for Methods editor readiness. FiguresHost shows the current reading/refusal reason as an explicit visible status while the editor is disabled. Typed internal MethodsStatus.GenerationUnavailable follows actual availability and clears after all required data arrive; explicit author-action messages stay unchanged. MethodsVM, stored document/science/journal vocabulary and generated scientific wording are unchanged.

Independent review confirmed existing per-figure drafts already preserve edits through asynchronous cache replies. New pure regressions exercise all six summary/report/facts arrival orders, authored edits after readiness, editing an existing draft during refused facts, late recovery and regeneration choice, and transient Reading status clearance. Actual gated FiguresHost callbacks verify disabled/visible loading and refusal, real recovery, keyboard-authored edits retained after a late genuine callback, and no duplicate NoFigure status. Focused strict tests: MethodsGeneratorSuite19/19 JVM and19/19 JS; FigureMethodsFxSuite6/6 headless.

No timeout or performance/scientific threshold was widened. Studio style and boundaries passed.
